boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named stops on Lincoln, Weinbach, and Boeke corridors immediately beside or within the practical orbit of campus.

cards.title: Lincoln Commons — new corner retail
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Avenue corridor at Weinbach Avenue
cards.notes: Start at the Lincoln–Weinbach corner and look for the four-story complex; its lower level was built for retail tenants.
cards.short_summary: A named campus-edge building with retail on the lower level.
cards.evidence_claim: UE says Lincoln Commons is a four-story student-housing complex at Lincoln and Weinbach Avenues with 3,500 square feet of lower-level retail.
cards.source_title: Lincoln Commons to Welcome Third Evansville Qdoba Location on October 28
cards.access_notes: Retail access and tenant hours vary; confirm directly before making a special trip.

cards.title: Qdoba — fast-casual Mexican food
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Avenue corridor at Weinbach Avenue
cards.notes: Use the lower-level Lincoln Commons storefront when you want a quick meal; check the restaurant directly for current ordering and hours.
cards.short_summary: A Qdoba storefront in Lincoln Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: UE announced Qdoba as Lincoln Commons' first retail tenant and described it as a fast-casual Mexican restaurant.
cards.source_title: Lincoln Commons to Welcome Third Evansville Qdoba Location on October 28
cards.access_notes: Food purchase is required; verify current hours with the business.

cards.title: Orange Leaf — self-serve frozen yogurt
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Avenue corridor at Weinbach Avenue
cards.notes: Pair this stop with the Lincoln Commons corner retail; select and pay for frozen yogurt at the storefront.
cards.short_summary: A self-serve frozen-yogurt stop at the campus-edge corner.
cards.evidence_claim: UE identified Orange Leaf as a self-serve frozen yogurt chain and one of the first lower-level retail tenants at Lincoln Commons.
cards.source_title: Lincoln Commons to Welcome Third Evansville Qdoba Location on October 28
cards.access_notes: Purchase is required; verify current hours with the business.

cards.title: Honey Moon Coffee — original shop
cards.subtitle: Weinbach Avenue corridor at Lincoln Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the original Honey Moon shop at 612 S. Weinbach; choose from its coffee and food menu, then confirm hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Honey Moon Coffee Co.'s original Evansville shop.
cards.evidence_claim: Honey Moon Coffee Co. calls its 612 S. Weinbach Avenue location its original shop and lists it in Evansville.
cards.source_title: Honey Moon Coffee Co. — Weinbach Location
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks require purchase; current hours should be confirmed with the business.

cards.title: Bluestocking Social — books and art supplies
cards.subtitle: Weinbach Avenue corridor at Lincoln Avenue
cards.notes: Browse contemporary and classic books or art supplies at this named shop; check its current listing for hours before you go.
cards.short_summary: A bookstore and art-supply destination on Weinbach.
cards.evidence_claim: Bluestocking Social describes itself as a bookstore for readers of all ages and an art supply store for artists of all skill levels.
cards.access_notes: Items require purchase; the source lists weekday and Saturday shop hours.

cards.title: The Slice — Lincoln Avenue pizza
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Avenue corridor near campus
cards.notes: Find The Slice at 2011 Lincoln Avenue for pizza; use the restaurant’s own page to verify service and ordering details before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A pizza restaurant directly on Lincoln Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Slice lists its Evansville location at 2011 Lincoln Avenue and publishes its business hours on its official site.
cards.access_notes: Food purchase is required. The official site lists service Monday through Saturday.

cards.title: Rare Bird — maker and fair-trade goods
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Avenue corridor east of campus
cards.notes: Browse the shop at 2605 Lincoln Avenue for gifts, crafts, games, and regional-themed items; check posted hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A Lincoln Avenue gift shop carrying goods from small makers.
cards.evidence_claim: Rare Bird lists its address as 2605 Lincoln Avenue and says it carries products from small independent makers and fair-trade vendors.
cards.access_notes: Merchandise requires purchase; the business posts current hours on its website.

cards.title: Swonder Ice Arena — public skating
cards.subtitle: Boeke Road corridor north of Lincoln Avenue
cards.notes: Check the public-skating calendar and arrive for a listed session; the city identifies two NHL regulation-sized ice arenas at this site.
cards.short_summary: A city ice arena with scheduled public-skating sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Evansville lists Swonder Ice Arena at 209 N. Boeke Road and publishes public-skating sessions.
cards.access_notes: Admission and skate-rental fees are indicated in city budget materials; confirm session availability and prices before visiting.

cards.title: Wesselman Woods — marked walking trails
cards.subtitle: Boeke Road corridor south of Lincoln Avenue
cards.notes: Enter from Wesselman Park at 551 N. Boeke Road, stay on marked trails, and plan for admission during the Nature Center’s posted hours.
cards.short_summary: A managed nature preserve with trails and a Nature Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Wesselman Woods lists 551 N. Boeke Road as its location and says admission includes access to more than four miles of walking trails.
cards.access_notes: Admission is charged for most visitors; follow posted preserve rules, including staying on marked trails.

cards.title: Lorraine Park — pool, playground, and picnic area
cards.subtitle: Adams Avenue corridor south of Lincoln Avenue
cards.notes: Use the city facilities listing to identify Lorraine Park’s pool, playground, shelter, and picnic area; seasonal pool operations vary.
cards.short_summary: A city park combining recreation and seasonal pool facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Evansville lists Lorraine Park with Lorraine Pool, a playground, shelter, and picnic area.
cards.source_title: City of Evansville Parks and Recreation Facilities List
cards.access_notes: Park amenities are listed by the city; pool admission and seasonal opening status must be confirmed before visiting.
